index.name: TGG, single-pole fit to Schlarb & Sugg 1994
index.source: least-squares fit of n^2 = A + B l^2/(l^2 - C) to the nine measured points of U. Schlarb and B. Sugg, Phys. Status Solidi B 182, K91 (1994) (refractiveindex.info main/Tb3Ga5O12/Schlarb, 0.40466-1.17668 um, 20 C): largest deviation 6.6e-4
index.uncertainty: fit residual 6.6e-4 inside the measured range; extrapolation outside 0.40-1.18 um is not backed by data. The previous two-point fit (A = 1, B = 2.7769, C = 0.01656) was 0.011 away from the table at 1.08 um.
